metric.description: F1 = 2 TP/(2 TP+FP+FN) over the entire 215,488-entry frozen subset; a zero denominator yields zero. Predicted stable iff predicted formation energy <= frozen hull energy; true stable iff signed reference hull distance <= 0. Higher is better. No rounding or outlier/success filter. Report stability_f1 and confusion counts; linear_maximize display anchors use the archived CHGNet replay and a valid all-stable constant-energy method.
